our_interpretation: The speaker expressly includes embarrassment within losing. It would change the claim to substitute a universal negative financial return.
The statement combines reputational harm, earnings deterioration, investor destruction, continued spending and a causal claim about collapse severity.
No single ordinary measurement preserves all those meanings. A narrower financial forecast would require choosing investor groups, return measures and a comparison the speaker did not supply.
The conversational phrase I think is not itself the reason for declining adjudication.
criteria.support_condition: No fair binary support condition can be specified for the complete wording without adding a definition of losing and a measurable comparison for collapse severity.
criteria.contradiction_condition: No fair binary contradiction condition can be specified: a profitable investor could still suffer embarrassment under the stated definition, while temporary losses do not establish ultimate destruction.
